subject: general
question: After independence, the Census Act was enacted in India in the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1948**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Census Act was enacted in India in the year **1948**, soon after the country gained independence.
 
• This Act provides for the detailed procedures and methodologies for conducting the census in India.
 
• The census is a critical tool for collecting demographic data, which is used for planning and policy-making in the country.
 
• India's first post-independence census was conducted in 1951 under this Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is one of the largest administrative exercises conducted in the country, occurring every ten years.
 
• The census provides comprehensive data on population size, distribution, and various socio-economic and demographic characteristics.
 
• The data collected from the census is used for a wide range of purposes, including the allocation of resources, the planning of infrastructure, and the implementation of various government programs.
 
• Over the years, the Census Act has been amended to incorporate new methodologies and technologies for data collection and processing.
